topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes for the hallmarks of cancer
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the learning outcomes and conceptual framework for understanding the hallmarks of cancer.

topics.label: Growth signaling pathways and mutations driving proliferation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how oncogenic mutations in cell surface receptors and intracellular signaling cascades drive sustained proliferation and cell survival.

topics.label: Differentiation block in hematopoietic and epithelial cancers
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how impaired cellular differentiation contributes to malignant transformation in both hematopoietic and epithelial tissues.

topics.label: Resistance to apoptosis and apoptotic pathway regulation
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores how cancer cells evade programmed cell death through alterations in the p53 pathway and Bcl-2 family proteins.

topics.label: Telomere biology, cellular senescence, and p53 stress responses
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the mechanisms of telomere shortening, senescence bypass, and how p53 coordinates cellular stress responses to limit cell immortality.

topics.label: Cancer metabolism and metabolic reprogramming
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss the metabolic rewiring of cancer cells, including aerobic glycolysis, tissue-specific metabolism, and oncometabolite generation.

topics.label: Tumor angiogenesis and neovascularization
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes the role and timing of neovascularization in overcoming hypoxia to sustain tumor growth.

topics.label: Mechanisms, monitoring, and genomics of cancer metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics analyze the biological stages, diagnostic monitoring, and genomic characteristics of metastatic tumor spread.

topics.label: Summary and concluding remarks
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer summarizes the major themes of cancer hallmarks and delivers closing remarks.
